text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Difference in quantile score (twice the mean pinball loss over 11 quantiles, points of effective capacity) between two convex-model forecasts, at each of 12 quarterly origins and pooled at the right. Below zero favours the first-named forecast. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling one-week blocks (pooled: 98.75% interval from resampling months). Grey bar: tie band, one standard error. D5, D10, D11, D14, and D16 once each has 36 months of history.'
